name: wayi-local
description: WAYI en local : serveur + appli client + espace restaurant/admin + appli livreur, en une commande

scripts.installer: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix apps/client && npm install --prefix apps/ops && npm install --prefix apps/driver && node scripts/creer-env-local.js
scripts.dev: node scripts/creer-env-local.js && concurrently -k -n serveur,client,restaurant,livreur -c green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run serveur" "npm run dev --prefix apps/client" "npm run dev --prefix apps/ops" "npm run dev --prefix apps/driver"
